scope: Verify OBJECTS section rollback after the core has staged an IMAGEDEF graph, followed by same-writer retry and typed readback.

behavior: The IMAGEDEF plan failure/retry control now injects a malformed XRECORD value from the consumer OBJECTS callback after the core has emitted its NOD, GROUP, IMAGEDEF dictionary, reactor, and IMAGEDEF records.
The failed callback must preserve the pre-existing destination sentinel and clear derived entity identity maps.
Correcting the callback on the same writer must succeed; a fresh typed DXF import verifies the IMAGE, IMAGEDEF, reactor references, and independent XRECORD.
The sequence runs for ASCII and Binary DXF. It adds no repository DWG/DXF fixtures and establishes no support claim.

normalFocused.coverage: Both ASCII and Binary generated IMAGEDEF flows, earlier entity-callback failure rollback, later OBJECTS callback failure after core records were staged, destination preservation, identity rollback, corrected same-writer retry, and fresh typed readback.

limitations: The injected failure is a rejected XRECORD value in the adapter callback, not a bad_alloc inside each core OBJECTS builder.
The generated round-trip is local transport evidence; native consumer semantics, physical producer breadth, and independent interoperability remain unqualified.
next: Inject allocation failures into independent OBJECTS builders and extend rollback controls to other staged families.
